title: How Do DiTs Denoise? An Aggregator-Predictor View of Attention and MLPs
title_zh: DiT如何去噪？注意力与MLP的聚合器-预测器视角

paragraphs.en: 提出聚合器-预测器视角，将DiT的注意力和MLP解释为上下文聚合与patch预测的功能组件。 How do diffusion transformers (DiTs) represent image content and learn rules for reusing it to generalize? We develop an aggregator--predictor view of DiTs as input-adaptive local denoisers, in which context aggregation and patch prediction provide functional roles for interpreting attention and MLPs. We first establish that, for Gaussian Markov random field (GMRF) priors, the global Bayes denoiser can be approximated using only a subset of context patches, with error decaying exponentially in context radius. We further show that patchwise linear denoisers, often invoked to explain diffusion generalization, recover the empirical local denoiser with sufficiently informative aggregation. Within this view, AdaLN-modulated attention naturally parameterizes an input- and noise-dependent aggregator, while the MLP admits a learned key--value representation for tokenwise patch prediction. Our experiments support this view. DiTs trained on real images exhibit noise-dependent denoising contexts resembling those in the analytic GMRF setting, while attention mass exhibits a qualitatively corresponding broadening pattern. In a controlled CelebA64 study, shared-memory patch predictors used in place of DiT MLPs achieve competitive denoising and generative performance. Finally, cross-dataset component transplantation reveals compatibility patterns consistent with the proposed roles of QK in spatial weighting, VO in feature transport, and MLPs in patch prediction. Together, these results provide a component-level account of DiT denoising and motivate architecture-specific fine-tuning and controlled intervention.
paragraphs.zh: 提出聚合器-预测器视角，将DiT的注意力和MLP解释为上下文聚合与patch预测的功能组件。扩散Transformer（DiT）如何表示图像内容，并学习复用这些内容以实现泛化的规则？ 我们发展了一种将DiT视为输入自适应局部去噪器的聚合器-预测器视角，其中上下文聚合与patch预测为解释注意力和MLP提供了功能性角色。 我们首先证明，对于高斯马尔可夫随机场（GMRF）先验，全局贝叶斯去噪器可以仅用一部分上下文patch来近似，其误差随上下文半径呈指数衰减。 我们进一步表明，常被用来解释扩散泛化的逐patch线性去噪器，在聚合信息足够充分时能够恢复经验局部去噪器。 在这一视角下，AdaLN调制的注意力自然地参数化了一个依赖输入和噪声的聚合器，而MLP则为逐token的patch预测提供了一种可学习的键-值表示。 我们的实验支持这一视角。 在真实图像上训练的DiT表现出依赖于噪声的去噪上下文，与解析GMRF设定中的情形相似，同时注意力质量呈现出定性上相应的展宽模式。 在受控的CelebA64研究中，用共享记忆的patch预测器替代DiT中的MLP，取得了具有竞争力的去噪与生成性能。 最后，跨数据集的组件移植揭示了与所提角色相符的兼容性模式：QK负责空间加权，VO负责特征传递，MLP负责patch预测。 总而言之，这些结果为DiT去噪提供了组件层面的解释，并激励了面向特定架构的微调与受控干预研究。
